newsitems.title: REDstreams — Cyberpunk 2077: Edgerunners 2 Update (2.5) is coming!
newsitems.author: Vattier
newsitems.contents: [p]Chrome up, chooms! A new, free update for Cyberpunk 2077 is coming on October 22nd. And it sounds like a perfect time for another REDstreams.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210272/fc45f59555738e1088bb9bbc1395dd778aeba221.png"][/img][/p][p]Join us this Wednesday, October 21st at 5 PM CEST for a closer look at Edgerunners 2 Update (2.5) and some of its new features. We're talking cyberware customization, a new dual-wielding playstyle, and more![/p][p][/p][p]Tune in on Twitch, YouTube or Steam:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="http://twitch.tv/cdprojektred"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtube.com/live/nhlnT9FzgJ8"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]A huge thank you to Taisei Uchida (Original Art), Yukiko Kakita (Ink & Paint Check), and Yuichiro Tozawa (Special Effects) for their contributions to the Cyberpunk 2077 Edgerunners 2 Update (2.5) official illustration.[/p]

newsitems.title: REDstreams – Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2
newsitems.author: Vattier
newsitems.contents: [p]Finished watching Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2? Good. We need to talk.[/p][p][/p][p]Join us for a special Edgerunners edition of REDstreams as we look back at Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 with Bartosz Sztybor and Saya Elder.[/p][p][/p][p]📅 Tuesday, October 27th, 5 PM CET[/p][p][/p][p]We will be live on Twitch, YouTube and Steam![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.twitch.tv/cdprojektred"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtube.com/live/Pa1PyPX9fsg"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]See you in chat, chooms 🤘[/p]
